row.evidence: Planhat's help centre says to "Use SCIM 2.0 to automatically provision, update, and deactivate users in Planhat directly from your identity provider", while every pricing package is "Enquire" with no public price.
row.notes: Quote-only: Planhat publishes no prices; the CRM, CSP and PSA packages all say "Enquire", and the pricing page lists Advanced Security, User Management, Open API and Audit Logs as "Included in all plans" without naming SSO or SCIM. SCIM 2.0 (Users, Groups) launched with help articles dated Sept 2026; it may need the CSM/TDS to enable the SCIM permission. Deleting a user in the IdP deactivates them in Planhat. SAML SSO (Okta, Azure AD, Google, ADFS, custom) must be enabled by Planhat staff and does not create users (no JIT). REST user API (create, update, list, delete, bulk upsert) on all plans.

plans.name: All packages (CRM, CSP, PSA)
plans.notes: Pricing page shows no plan names or prices in its static HTML; "Included in all plans" lists Advanced Security, User Management, Open API, Advanced Permissions and Audit Logs.

auth.token_source: Settings (Global Tool) > Security > User Provisioning > generate a new Bearer Token

operations.notes: A user deleted in the IdP is deactivated in Planhat, not deleted.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated (inactive) users cannot log in or get notifications but remain available for assigning accounts; on manual removal, emails, notes, chats and tickets stay owned by the removed user while companies, workflows and tasks are reassigned.

group: displayName (group name matched exactly to a mapped Planhat Role)

roles.how: IdP group-to-role mapping in Planhat (Security > User Provisioning); users assigned directly get the configured Default User Role; leaving a mapped group removes that role.

limitations.text: Existing VIEW users cannot receive roles that need CORE user type via SCIM; the mapping fails silently until the user type is upgraded manually. SCIM-created users are CORE.
Okta "Push Now" fully overwrites the Planhat role membership, removing users assigned manually in Planhat.
First and last name are required; PATCH with only unsupported fields returns 400.
SCIM permission may need to be enabled by the Planhat CSM/TDS.

scim.notes: SCIM must first be switched on in Roles > Workflow Permission > SCIM User Provisioning; if that permission is missing the customer has to ask their CSM/TDS.

endpoints.purpose: Update user (incl. inactive flag and roles)
Get user by ID (or externalId with prefix)

audit_log_api.notes: Pricing lists Audit Logs in all plans; no audit-log API endpoint was found.

rate_limits.text: Soft quota 200 calls/minute on the main API; hard limit 150 requests/second with bursts up to 50 parallel requests.

okta.notes: OIN page checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push. built_by inferred from Planhat documenting its own OIN app.

entra.notes: No gallery tutorial (planhat-tutorial 404); Planhat tells admins to create their own (non-gallery) enterprise application with the generic SCIM URL.

google.notes: Planhat documents Google Workspace (GSuite) SAML SSO; no Google catalogue page checked.

onelogin.notes: Planhat's own OneLogin guide uses OneLogin's generic SAML Custom Connector (Advanced); no SCIM setup for OneLogin is documented.
